hero.lede: Ten years of full-stack engineering. Two years taking a multi-agent system from zero to production. Now building AI products: defining tasks, designing workflows, evaluating — and writing code to test the judgment.

items.title: Define the task before the model
items.body: The model isn't the product. The task is.

items.title: Evaluation is not a benchmark
items.body: What counts as success, how failures are caught, whether the cost holds.

items.title: Engineering depth is about trade-offs
items.body: Turning capability into cost, risk and delivery pace.

case.title: One example
case.name: Turning ad asset production into an agent workflow
case.context: 100,000 videos and 30,000+ images per month, produced through a manual, serial workflow.
case.decision: Instead of asking the model to generate everything, split planning, generation and review into orchestrated tasks.
case.result: 80%+ cross-team efficiency; cost per video from RMB 2.5–3 to RMB 0.5–1.

items.title: Define
items.body: Users, scenario, constraints. Write down what it won't do first.

items.title: Prototype
items.body: Build the demo myself, test capability limits on real tasks.

items.title: Deliver
items.body: Ship with engineering, research and design.
